label: Подключить готовый ChatGPT adapter к AHAP без переписывания driver
description: Минимальный TS wrapper существующих BrowserChatAdapter/provider factory для ChatGPT. Повторно использовать OpenCode runner a3a514fa+c3b5aa58 как protocol образец; общие файлы OpenCode не менять. Direct CDP, точный instance/account; fake contract без live sends. This reuses ChatGptMacCdpDriver through its factory and keeps the existing transport; source check confirms MacMiniChromeTransport is SSH -> http_stdio.py -> Chrome DevTools MCP tools/call, not direct CDP. Exact driver tools: list_pages, new_page, evaluate_script, take_snapshot, fill, navigate_page. Project has npm ws and uses it in Codex/ZCode sockets, but no existing CDP client. Direct-CDP criterion remains open; no live/browser/send or CI run. Need compile/test receipts and immutable commit next.

Committed owned files as ed1acd95e34bd3f (src/ahap-browser-runner.ts, tests/ahap-browser-runner.test.ts only). tsc --noEmit PASS; focused Vitest 4/4 PASS; fake contract covers initialize/init/create/read/send, account pin mismatch and UNKNOWN without retry. No CI, live browser or send. Direct-CDP remains a distinct open criterion: current MacMiniChromeTransport uses the six Chrome DevTools MCP tools over SSH. Source inventory shows npm package ws is available and used by Codex/ZCode WebSocket clients, but there is no existing CDP client. Proposed direct transport seam is a ChromePageTools.call implementation replacing only the transport: list_pages, new_page, evaluate_script, take_snapshot, fill, navigate_page; protocol mapping needs exact CDP command implementation and separate acceptance.
